changes: Specified two disposable identities and active local AuthUser records for browser account switching.
Added real browser session-expiry assertion using a short bounded development test lifetime.
Added forwarded scheme/host and same-origin mutation/foreign-Origin assertions through the Aspire + Vite path.
Added verified email, configured subject mapping, and rejection of unverified or mismatched identities.
Made logout revocation explicit by requiring server-side cookie-ticket storage and rejection of a copied pre-logout cookie.
Recorded the development-only in-memory ticket store as a single-process choice, not a production session-store decision.
Reviewer approved the amendment and requested the issue acceptance criteria align with the plan.
Added a forged-state OIDC callback rejection check, real authorization-code PKCE option assertions, and inspection of Keycloak PAR use in the browser journey.
Added a real antiforgery form-token middleware test using the configured antiforgery service.
Extended browser evidence to scan local/session storage keys and values, IndexedDB records, and same-origin JSON responses for provider tokens or JWTs.
Adapted system theme resolution to follow OS changes and honored reduced-motion preferences while keeping the existing palette.
Added real browser checks for light/dark/system appearance, visible keyboard focus, 390px viewport overflow, and reduced motion.
Restored the Lighthouse-managed DESIGN.md projection and clarified DomusMind visual authority in its own design index.
